title: Joe and the Very Helpful Tail
synopsis: A puppy tries to keep his wagging tail out of the way while Dad tidies the sitting room, only to discover what it has found.

related_resources.reason: Repeated actions and a familiar room offer an optional opportunity to anticipate what the tail might bump next.
The story invites playful predictions about a puppy’s movements without asserting that this plot teaches a particular skill.
